generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent master candidate for a 2D top-down survival game character sprite, content ID FIXTURE-CHARACTER-AGILE, role BODY.
Primary request: one small agile goblin survivor escaping an overwhelming pursuit; sympathetic and expressive, roughly 65% appealing and 35% scruffy/odd, anxious, clever, stubbornly determined to survive.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, isolated cutout only.
Style/medium: original hand-drawn 2D storybook cutout illustration; simple confident shapes; thick deep-plum outer contour; flat matte colors; restrained dry-brush/paper texture inside large color masses; simple cel shading; not pixel art and not 3D.
Composition/framing: single full-body character centered on a square canvas, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, neutral animation-ready stance with weight centered above the feet, slight forward readiness but no action pose; entire ears, hands, feet, clothing and accessory visible; generous transparent padding on all sides; visible silhouette about 72–76% of canvas height; horizontal ground-contact line; designed to remain readable at small gameplay scale and survive horizontal flip.
Subject invariants: compact slightly lean goblin, large readable ears, expressive alert eyes, moss/olive-green skin, rust/clay main clothing accent, small dusty-teal secondary accent, free empty hands, no permanent weapon, arms slightly separated from torso, legs visually separated, one simple improvised accessory only.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral-warm ambient from above and slightly in front; one broad shadow mass and at most one small highlight; adventurous fairy-tale comedy with real danger, no gore.
Technical constraints: actual alpha transparency; clean antialiased edges without matte halo; no baked ground shadow; no ground plane; no environment; no frame; no UI card; no text, letters, numbers, logo, signature or watermark; no cropped parts; no motion blur, speed lines, glow, particles or impact effects; no tiny high-frequency ornaments; no copyrighted character imitation; no extra limbs, duplicated items or ambiguous anatomy; no extreme perspective; no baby mascot proportions; no horror creature; no photorealism; no plastic 3D render.
Variant 1 — satchel runner: slightly triangular silhouette with broad ears and narrow lower body; short patched rust tunic; one small dusty-teal cross-body satchel resting close to the hip; wary raised brows and focused eyes. Keep the satchel compact so it will not collide with the body during squash/stretch.
